razonamiento: Merged visual nodes with spoken services: UserConsumerMobile (b0) represents the mobile/checking app, UserConsumerAPI (b1) represents the third-party reseller/API client, b8 represents the external CDN, b2 is S3 for web hosting, b3 is AppSync, b4 is API Gateway, b5 is SQS, b6 is Lambda, and b7 is DynamoDB. Visual duplicate line b0->b8 was consolidated. Bidirectional flows between clients/S3/AppSync and the CDN were preserved as drawn and narrated across three main flows: static web hosting, GraphQL operations via AppSync, and external API requests via API Gateway.
nombre: Serverless Multi-Tenant Event-Driven Architecture with AppSync and API Gateway
